SELECT 
  fish_date_doy, 
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / COUNT(*), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip,
  ROUND(AVG(anglers), 1) as avg_anglers
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 287 AND 297
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 2) as avg_wtmp_c,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c) * 9/5 + 32, 1) as avg_wtmp_f,
  COUNT(*) as measurements
FROM pier
WHERE ts_doy >= 140
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 2) as avg_wtmp_c,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c) * 9/5 + 32, 1) as avg_wtmp_f,
  COUNT(*) as measurements
FROM pier
WHERE ts_doy BETWEEN 140 AND 155
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy
